words.ex_cn: 这支队伍有很强的团队精神。
words.en: A feeling of pride, fellowship, and common loyalty shared by the members of a particular group.

words.ex: He won the game with great finesse.
words.ex_cn: 他以高超的技巧赢得了比赛。
words.en: If you finesse something, you handle it in a skillful and often slightly deceptive way.

words.tr: n. 手法；骗术；花招；诡诈
words.ex: His success was due to a bit of legerdemain in the deal.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功归功于交易中的一点小把戏。
words.en: Skillful use of one's hands when performing conjuring tricks.

words.tr: n. 身体不适；不快；萎靡不振；痼疾
words.ex: She felt a general malaise after the long flight.
words.ex_cn: 长途飞行后，她感到全身不适。
words.en: A general feeling of discomfort, illness, or unease whose exact cause is difficult to identify.

words.tr: phrase. 贵人应有的品德；位高则任重；贵族义务（指贵族或上层人士应负的社会责任）
words.ex: He gave money to the poor because of noblesse oblige.
words.ex_cn: 他因为贵族义务而给穷人钱。
words.en: The idea that people of high rank or birth should behave nobly and honorably.

words.ex: They have good rapport with their students.
words.ex_cn: 他们与学生关系友好。
words.en: A friendly relationship in which people understand each other very well.

words.ex: Despite the chaos around him, he maintained his sangfroid.
words.ex_cn: 尽管周围一片混乱，他依然保持冷静。
words.en: If you say that someone has sangfroid, you mean that they are able to remain calm in a dangerous or difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 处事圆滑；待人接物的技巧；得体的举止
words.ex: He has savoir faire in every social situation.
words.ex_cn: 他在每种社交场合中都有分寸感。
words.en: The ability to act or speak appropriately in social situations.

chapters.name: 第六章 出自法语 G4

words.tr: n. 告别；辞行; int. 再见；再会
words.ex: He said adieu to his friends before leaving town.
words.ex_cn: 他离开镇子前向朋友们道别。
words.en: A farewell or goodbye.

words.tr: phrase. 再见（用于暂时分别时）
words.ex: She said au revoir and left the room.
words.ex_cn: 她说了一声再见，然后离开了房间。
words.en: A French expression used to say goodbye, literally meaning 'until we see each other again'.

words.ex: He wrote a billet-doux to his sweetheart.
words.ex_cn: 他给心爱的人写了一封情书。
words.en: A billet-doux is a love letter or a note expressing romantic feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 妙语；机智的双关语
words.ex: He dropped a bon mot at the dinner party.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚宴上说了一句妙语。
words.en: A bon mot is a clever and amusing remark.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: The story was a complete canard, spread by those with vested interests.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事完全是一个谣言，是由那些有既得利益的人散布的。
words.en: A canard is a false or baseless story or piece of information, especially one that is deliberately misleading.

words.ex: He used a cliche to describe the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个陈词滥调来形容日落。
words.en: A cliché is an idea or phrase that has been used so much that it is no longer interesting or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 只有我们之间知道的；私下说的，内部的（法语借词，意为‘在我们之间’）
words.ex: Entre nous, I think the plan will fail.
words.ex_cn: 我们之间说说，我觉得这个计划会失败。
words.en: Used to indicate that what you are about to say should be kept secret.

words.tr: phrase. 最贴切的词语；恰到好处的用词
words.ex: He searched for the mot juste to describe his feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他寻找最恰当的词语来描述他的感受。
words.en: The exactly right word or phrase to express what you want to say.

words.tr:
n. 摘要；大纲
v. 为…写摘要；概括…的大意
words.ex: He wrote a précis of the long report for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他为会议写了一份长报告的摘要。
words.en: A précis is a short summary of a larger work, capturing the main points and essence of the original material.

words.tr: n. 敏捷的回答；机智的回答
words.ex: The witty repartee between the two comedians kept the audience laughing.
words.ex_cn: 两位喜剧演员之间的机智对话让观众笑声不断。
words.en: A repartee is a quick, witty reply or a conversation full of such replies.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.tr: n. 还击；机敏的回答; vi. 回击；机敏地回答
words.ex: He delivered a clever riposte to her accusation.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的指控给出了机智的回应。
words.en: A riposte is a quick and clever reply to an insult or criticism, or a quick return thrust in fencing.

words.tr: n. 面对面的谈话；密谈
words.ex: He runs tte--tte every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: A private conversation between two people.

chapters.name: 第六章 出自法语 G5

words.tr: phrase. 最讨厌的人或物；棘手的问题
words.ex: Mosquitoes are his bête noire during summer.
words.ex_cn: 蚊子是他夏天最讨厌的东西。
words.en: A person or thing that one particularly dislikes or dreads.

words.tr: phrase. 完全的自由或授权，全权处理
words.ex: The manager gave her carte blanche to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 经理给了她全权处理这个问题的自由。
words.en: If someone gives you carte blanche, they give you the authority to do whatever you think is best in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 引起公众广泛关注的事件或问题
words.ex: The accident was caused by a celebration that got out of control.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故是由一场失控的庆祝活动引起的。
words.en: A cause célèbre is an issue or incident that attracts a great deal of public attention and debate, often because it involves a famous person or is of great public interest.

words.ex: The new policy led the company into a cul-de-sac.
words.ex_cn: 新政策使公司陷入了困境。
words.en: A cul-de-sac is a short road which is closed off at one end.

words.ex: The team's loss was a total debacle.
words.ex_cn: 球队的失败是一场彻底的惨败。
words.en: A debacle is a sudden and complete failure or collapse, often in a way that is very embarrassing or causes a lot of damage.

words.tr: phrase. 已成事实；既成事实（指已经发生且无法改变的事情）
words.ex: The new rule was a fait accompli when we found out.
words.ex_cn: 当我们发现时，这个新规定已经成了既成事实。
words.en: If something is a fait accompli, it has already been decided or done and cannot be changed.

words.tr: phrase. 失礼；失态；社交中的失当行为
words.ex: He made a faux pas by wearing jeans to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿牛仔裤去参加婚礼，犯了个礼仪错误。
words.en: A faux pas is a socially awkward or tactless act, especially one that violates accepted social norms, standard customs, or the rules of etiquette.

words.tr: n. 绝境；僵局；死路；死胡同
words.ex: The talks reached an impasse and no one could move forward.
words.ex_cn: 谈判陷入了僵局，没有人能继续前进。
words.en: An impasse is a situation in which no progress can be made or no advancement is possible, especially because of disagreement; a deadlock.

words.ex: He is the liaison between the two departments.
words.ex_cn: 他是两个部门之间的联络人。
words.en: A liaison is a person who acts as a link to assist communication between different groups or organizations.

words.tr: n. 混合物；文学作品的杂集
words.ex: The chef prepared a melange of spices for the dish.
words.ex_cn: 厨师为这道菜准备了一种混合香料。
words.en: A mixture of different elements, especially a collection or medley of various items or types.

words.ex: He saw a mirage in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 他在沙漠中看到了海市蜃楼。
words.en: An optical illusion caused by atmospheric conditions, especially the appearance of a sheet of water in a desert or on a hot road caused by the refraction of light from the sky by heated air.

chapters.name: 第六章 出自法语 G6

words.ex: The army carried out a coup d'etat last night.
words.ex_cn: 军队昨晚发动了一次政变。
words.en: A coup d'état is a sudden, violent, and illegal seizure of power from a government.

words.tr: n. 行动方针；外交步骤；策略
words.ex: The diplomat made a demarche to protest the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这位外交官提出抗议，反对这项新法律。
words.en: A démarche is a step or initiative, especially in diplomacy, aimed at achieving a particular goal or resolving a conflict.

words.tr: n. 缓和；放松；缓和时期
words.ex: The two countries are trying detente to reduce tension.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家正试图通过缓和关系来减少紧张。
words.en: Détente is a state of calm or friendly relations between two countries, especially after a period of tension or conflict.

words.ex: France and Britain have an entente about trade.
words.ex_cn: 法国和英国在贸易上有一个默契。
words.en: An entente is a friendly understanding or informal alliance between states or factions.

words.tr:
n. 自由放任主义；无干涉主义
adj. 放任主义的
words.ex: The government adopted a laissez-faire policy in economic matters.
words.ex_cn: 政府在经济事务上采取了放任政策。
words.en: A policy or attitude of letting things take their own course, without interfering.

words.tr: phrase. （法国旧制度下由国王签署并加盖封印的）密札；逮捕令；流放令
words.ex: The king signed a lettre de cachet to lock him in prison.
words.ex_cn: 国王签署了一封密封信，将他关进监狱。
words.en: A lettre de cachet was a letter signed by the king of France, countersigned by one of his ministers, and closed with the royal seal, or cachet. It contained orders directly from the king, often to enforce arbitrary actions and judgments that could not be appealed.

words.tr: n. 友好关系的恢复；和解
words.ex: The two countries began rapprochement after the war.
words.ex_cn: 两国在战争后开始和解。
words.en: An establishment or resumption of harmonious relations between two countries or groups.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

chapters.name: 第六章 出自法语 G7

words.tr:
adj. 先锋的；前卫的
n. 先锋派；前卫
words.ex: The artist uses avant-garde styles in her paintings.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在她的画作中使用前卫的风格。
words.en: Avant-garde is used to describe people or works that are experimental or innovative, particularly in the arts.

words.ex: The wall has a bas-relief of a lion.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一幅狮子的浅浮雕。
words.en: A type of sculpture in which shapes are cut so that they stand out slightly from the flat background.

words.ex: The conductor waved the baton to start the symphony.
words.ex_cn: 指挥家挥动指挥棒，开始交响乐。
words.en: A baton is a stick that is used by conductors to direct an orchestra or choir, by a relay runner to pass on the race, or by a police officer as a weapon.

words.ex: The painting is his chef d'oeuvre.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是他的杰作。
words.en: A chef d'oeuvre is a masterpiece, especially in art, literature, or music, representing the best work of an artist or creator.

words.ex: The denouement of the story was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的结局令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of a play, movie, or narrative in which the strands of the plot are drawn together and matters are explained or resolved.

words.tr: n. 再来一个；重演的节目
words.ex: The crowd shouted for an encore after the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会结束后，观众大声要求再演一场。
words.en: An encore is a short extra performance given by musicians or actors after the main performance has ended, usually in response to the audience's applause.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.ex: They watched a musicale last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚看了一部音乐剧。
words.en: A musicale is a social event at which music is performed, typically in a private home.

words.ex: The painter arranged his colors on the palette.
words.ex_cn: 画家把颜色放在调色板上。
words.en: A palette is a flat piece of wood, plastic, etc., on which an artist mixes paints.

words.ex: His repertoire includes singing, dancing, and acting.
words.ex_cn: 他的全部才能包括唱歌、跳舞和表演。
words.en: A repertoire is all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer or group knows and can perform.

words.tr: n. 小花饰；简介；（表演）片段
words.ex: She drew a small vignette on the corner of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 她在信的角落画了一个小花饰。
words.en: A vignette is a brief evocative description, account, or episode.

chapters.name: 第六章 出自法语 G8

words.tr: phrase. 按菜单定价点菜（与套餐相对）
words.ex: He ordered coffee à la carte.
words.ex_cn: 他单点了一杯咖啡。
words.en: If you choose à la carte, you choose individual dishes from a menu rather than having a complete meal that has been selected for you.

words.ex: He sipped on an aperitif before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚餐前小口品尝了一杯开胃酒。
words.en: An aperitif is an alcoholic drink that you have before a meal.

words.tr: n. 夹心软糖；（法）小糖果；棒棒糖
words.ex: He ate a bonbon after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一颗糖果。
words.en: A bonbon is a small sweet or piece of confectionery, especially one covered in chocolate.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.tr: n. 小型咖啡杯；小杯清咖啡
words.ex: He drank coffee from a demitasse.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小咖啡杯里喝咖啡。
words.en: A small cup used for serving strong coffee or espresso.

words.ex: He showed his entree to the concert hall.
words.ex_cn: 他向音乐厅出示了他的入场许可。
words.en: The main course of a meal; the act of entering.

words.tr: n. 方网眼的网；方网眼花边；肉片
words.ex: He cooked a filet of salmon for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他为晚餐煮了一块三文鱼排。
words.en: A fillet is a piece of meat or fish without bones.

words.tr: phrase. 开胃小菜；餐前小吃（通常为冷盘或小份热食）
words.ex: We ate hors d'oeuvres before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在晚饭前吃了开胃小菜。
words.en: Hors d'oeuvres are small amounts of food that are served before the main part of the meal.

words.tr: phrase. 主菜；压轴戏；最重要的东西
words.ex: The cake was the piece de resistance at the party.
words.ex_cn: 这块蛋糕是聚会上的亮点。
words.en: The most important or impressive feature of a creative work or event, often the final and most impressive part.

words.ex: The hotel has a table d'hote menu for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有晚餐的固定套餐菜单。
words.en: A table d'hôte is a meal served at a fixed price, with a limited number of dishes from which to choose.

chapters.name: 第六章 出自法语 G9

words.ex: She wore a bouffant hairstyle to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她参加派对时戴了一个蓬松的发型。
words.en: A bouffant hairstyle is one in which the hair is styled so that it stands out from the head in a rounded shape.

words.tr: n. 宽松连衣裙；女士宽松内衣（或睡衣）；无腰身女服；牧师白长袍；白色法衣；罩衫，工作服; n. （...
words.ex: She wears a white chemise to bed.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件白色衬衣睡觉。
words.en: A chemise is a type of women's undergarment or dress, typically sleeveless and often worn under other garments.

words.ex: She bought a new coiffure for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一个新发型。
words.en: A coiffure is a hairstyle, especially an elaborate one.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful corsage on her dress for the prom.
words.ex_cn: 她在晚礼服上佩戴了一朵漂亮的胸花。
words.en: A corsage is a small bouquet of flowers worn by women, typically on the wrist or pinned to the dress, for formal occasions.

words.ex: He wears a red cravat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴一条红色领结去参加派对。
words.en: A cravat is a piece of folded cloth which a man wears wrapped around his neck.

words.tr: adj. 艳丽的；炫耀的；神气活现的
words.ex: He wears flamboyant clothes to stand out.
words.ex_cn: 他穿著華麗的衣服來引人注目。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is flamboyant, you mean that they are very noticeable, stylish, and exciting.

words.ex: He wears a toupee to cover his bald head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴一顶假发来遮盖秃头。
words.en: A toupee is a small wig or hairpiece worn to cover a bald spot.

words.ex: Blue jeans are in vogue this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

chapters.name: 第六章 出自法语 G10

words.ex: The weight is measured in avoirdupois.
words.ex_cn: 重量是以常衡制衡量的。
words.en: A system of weights based on a pound of 16 ounces or 7,000 grains, used for measuring goods other than precious metals, gems, and drugs.

words.tr: n. 琐事，小事；弹子球戏的一种；轻快小曲; n. （Bagatelle）人名；（法）巴加泰勒
words.ex: He dismissed the issue as a bagatelle.
words.ex_cn: 他把这个问题视为微不足道的小事。
words.en: A bagatelle is something that is considered to be of little importance or value; a trifle. In music, it refers to a short, light piece of music, typically for the piano.

words.tr: phrase. 致命的一击；决定性的最后一击
words.ex: The final goal was the coup de grace that won the game.
words.ex_cn: 最后一个进球是赢得比赛的致命一击。
words.en: A coup de grâce is a decisive finishing blow, act, or event.

words.ex: The old building has a beautiful facade with stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老建筑有一个带有石柱的漂亮正面。
words.en: The front of a building, especially an imposing or decorative one. Also, a superficial appearance or illusion of something.

words.tr:
n. 游园会；庆祝；盛大节日
v. 宴请；招待
words.ex: The town held a fete to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇举办了一场集市来为学校筹款。
words.en: A fete is an outdoor event with stalls, games, and entertainments, often organized to raise money for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.ex: He feels comfortable in his artistic milieu.
words.ex_cn: 他在他的艺术环境中感到自在。
words.en: The milieu is the environment or setting in which something happens or develops.

words.tr: n. 阳伞; n. （Parasol）人名；（法）帕拉索尔
words.ex: She holds a parasol to shade herself from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 她撑着一把阳伞来遮挡阳光。
words.en: A parasol is an object like an umbrella that provides shade from the sun.

words.tr: phrase. /adj. 卓越地；出类拔萃地；作为最杰出或典型的代表
words.ex: She is a chef par excellence.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位卓越的厨师。
words.en: You say that something is a particular kind of thing par excellence in order to emphasize that it is a very good example of that kind of thing.

words.ex: He wore a pince-nez to read the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着眼镜夹鼻镜看报纸。
words.en: A pince-nez is a pair of glasses that clip onto the nose and do not have arms that go over the ears.

words.tr: phrase. 存在的理由；生存的目的
words.ex: For him, music is his raison d'etre.
words.ex_cn: 对他来说，音乐就是他存在的理由。
words.en: The most important reason or purpose for someone or something's existence.

words.tr: n. 会合地点；约会；集会
words.ex: They will rendezvous at the park at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在晚上6点在公园会合。
words.en: A rendezvous is a meeting that has been arranged between people, often secretly.

words.ex: The tree's silhouette stood against the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 树的剪影映在落日背景下。
words.en: A silhouette is the dark shape and outline of someone or something visible against a lighter background, especially in dim light.

words.ex: He was known by his sobriquet 'The Great Communicator'.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为绰号“伟大的沟通者”。
words.en: A sobriquet is a nickname or a familiar name, often a descriptive one, that is given to a person or thing.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 杰作；技艺的精彩展示；非凡的成就
words.ex: Her performance was a tour de force.
words.ex_cn: 她的表演堪称绝技。
words.en: A tour de force is an impressive achievement or performance that shows great skill or brilliance.

words.tr:
n. 面对面的人；两人对座的长椅
prep. 与…面对面；与…相对；关于
adv. 相向着；相对着
words.ex: The company's position vis--vis its competitors has improved.
words.ex_cn: 该公司相对于竞争对手的地位已经改善。
words.en: In relation to; with regard to.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G1

words.tr: n. 低音部；低音歌手；男低音歌手; n. （Basso）人名；（阿拉伯）巴苏；（英、法、西、意、葡...
words.ex: He plays the basso in the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在管弦乐队中演奏低音。
words.en: A basso is a male singer with a deep, low voice, or the part in music that is sung by such a voice.

words.tr: n. 男中音；男中音歌手
words.ex: He sings as a baritone in the choir.
words.ex_cn: 他在合唱团中担任男中音。
words.en: A baritone is a man's singing voice that is lower than a tenor but higher than a bass, or a singer with such a voice.

words.ex: The tenor of his speech was positive.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的大意是积极的。
words.en: The tenor of something such as a speech or piece of writing is its general meaning or the general attitude expressed in it.

words.tr:
n. 男声最高音；女低音
adj. 中音部的
words.ex: He sings alto in the church choir.
words.ex_cn: 他在教堂唱诗班中演唱男声最高音。
words.en: An alto is a woman with a low singing voice, or a boy with a high singing voice.

words.tr: n. 女低音，女低音歌唱家
words.ex: She sings as a contralto in the choir.
words.ex_cn: 她在合唱团中担任女低音。
words.en: A contralto is a type of classical female singing voice whose vocal range is the lowest female voice type.

words.tr: n. 女中音；女中音歌手
words.ex: She is a mezzo-soprano in the opera choir.
words.ex_cn: 她是歌剧合唱团中的次女高音。
words.en: A mezzo-soprano is a type of classical female singing voice whose range lies between the soprano and the contralto voice types.

words.ex: She sings as a soprano in the opera choir.
words.ex_cn: 她在歌剧合唱团中担任女高音。
words.en: A soprano is a type of classical female singing voice and has the highest vocal range of all voice types.

words.tr: n. 花腔；花腔女高音歌手; adj. 花腔的
words.ex: The soprano sings a coloratura passage with great skill.
words.ex_cn: 女高音以极高的技巧演唱了一段花腔段落。
words.en: A coloratura is a type of operatic singing that is very high and fast, with many notes being sung very quickly and in a very high range.

words.tr:
n. 假声
adj. 用假声的
adv. 用假声地
words.ex: The opera singer used falsetto to reach the high notes.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌剧演唱者用假声来唱高音。
words.en: A falsetto voice is a high singing voice that is produced by adult male singers who use a special technique to sing notes higher than their normal range.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G2

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.tr: n. 缓慢曲；广板; adv. 缓慢地；庄严地；宽广地; adj. 缓慢的；庄严的；宽广的; n. ...
words.ex: The music plays largo and slow.
words.ex_cn: 音乐缓慢而悠长地演奏。
words.en: In music, largo is a tempo marking meaning 'slow and stately' or 'broadly'. It is typically used to indicate a slow movement or section of a piece.

words.tr: adv.& adj. <音>缓慢的（地） n. 慢板; <音>柔板; <音>柔板乐章; <芭蕾>（男
words.ex: He plays the piano at adagio speed.
words.ex_cn: 他以柔板的速度弹钢琴。
words.en: In music, an adagio is a slow tempo, or a piece of music played at a slow tempo.

words.tr: adj. （尤指演奏演唱指示）缓慢的; adv. （尤指演奏演唱指示）缓慢地; n. 缓板; n. ...
words.ex: He plays the piano lento.
words.ex_cn: 他用慢板弹钢琴。
words.en: Lento is used to describe music that is played slowly. It is an Italian term that has been adopted into English musical terminology.

words.tr: n. 行板；行板乐曲；徐缓调; adv. 行板地；缓慢地; adj. 行板的；缓慢的
words.ex: He plays the piano andante.
words.ex_cn: 他以行板的速度弹钢琴。
words.en: In music, andante is a tempo marking indicating a moderately slow speed.

words.tr: adv. 中板地，中等速度地; adj. 中板的，（音乐演奏）中速的; n. 中庸速度演奏的乐段
words.ex: He plays the piano moderato.
words.ex_cn: 他以中速弹钢琴。
words.en: In music, 'moderato' is used to indicate a moderate tempo, neither too fast nor too slow.

words.tr: n. 快板；急速的乐章; adj. 快速的; adv. 急速地; n. （Allegro）人名；（法...
words.ex: He plays the piano at allegro speed.
words.ex_cn: 他以快板的速度弹钢琴。
words.en: In music, allegro indicates a quick, lively tempo.

words.tr: adj. （尤指演奏演唱提示）活泼的; adv. （尤指演奏演唱提示）活泼地; n. 表明活泼演奏的...
words.ex: The violin plays vivace in the first movement.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴在第一乐章中以活泼的速度演奏。
words.en: In music, vivace indicates a lively and fast tempo. As an adjective, it describes something or someone as lively and spirited.

words.tr: adj. 急板的; adv. 急板地; n. 急板；急板乐曲（或乐章、乐段）; int. 嘿，瞧; ...
words.ex: Presto! The magic trick is done.
words.ex_cn: 快看！魔术完成了。
words.en: Used to indicate the sudden appearance or occurrence of something often as if by magic.

words.tr: adj. 最快的; n. 最急板; adv. 最快速地
words.ex: He played the piano prestissimo.
words.ex_cn: 他以极快的速度弹钢琴。
words.en: In music, prestissimo is used to indicate that a passage should be played as fast as possible.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G3

words.tr: n. 声音渐增；高潮；顶峰
words.ex: The music reached a loud crescendo at the end.
words.ex_cn: 音乐在结尾处达到响亮的高潮。
words.en: A crescendo is a gradual increase in loudness or intensity in music, or any situation where there is a gradual increase in intensity.

words.tr: n. 渐弱；渐弱音; adj. 渐弱的; adv. 渐弱地
words.ex: The music played softly, then ended in a decrescendo.
words.ex_cn: 音乐渐渐变轻，最终以渐弱结束。
words.en: A decrescendo is a gradual decrease in loudness in a piece of music.

words.tr: adv. 甜美柔和地; adj. 甜美柔和的; n. （Dolce）（美、意）多尔斯（人名）
words.ex: The cake is dolce and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕是甜的。
words.en: In music, 'dolce' is an instruction to play or sing sweetly and softly.

words.tr:
n. 专长；特长
adv. 用强音
words.ex: His forte is playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他的强项是弹钢琴。
words.en: A thing at which someone excels.

words.tr: adj. 极强的；非常嘹亮的; adv. 极强地；非常响亮地; n. 用极强音奏的音，标记用极强音演...
words.ex: The pianist played fortissimo at the end of the song.
words.ex_cn: 钢琴家在歌曲结尾以极强音演奏。
words.en: In music, fortissimo is a dynamic marking that indicates a passage should be played very loudly.

words.tr: adv. 极轻柔地; adj. 极轻柔的; n. 乐曲中轻柔演奏的部分
words.ex: He played the piano pianissimo to make it soft.
words.ex_cn: 他弹钢琴时用极弱的音量，让声音轻柔。
words.en: A musical direction meaning 'very softly'.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.tr: n. 强调音符; adv. 加强地; adj. 加强的
words.ex: The violinist played the note sforzando.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手用突强奏出这个音符。
words.en: A musical direction indicating a note or chord to be played with a sudden, strong emphasis.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G4

words.tr: phrase. 无伴奏合唱的；无乐器伴奏的
words.ex: The choir performed an a cappella rendition of the classic hymn.
words.ex_cn: 合唱团无伴奏演唱了这首经典圣歌。
words.en: Without instrumental accompaniment.

words.ex: The pianist played an intricate arpeggio.
words.ex_cn: 钢琴家弹奏了一串复杂的琶音。
words.en: An arpeggio is a type of broken chord where the notes are played or sung in a sequence, one after the other, rather than simultaneously.

words.tr:
adv. 连奏地，连唱地
adj. 连奏的，连唱的
n. 连奏
words.ex: He played the piano legato, so the notes sounded smooth.
words.ex_cn: 他用连奏方式弹钢琴，所以音符听起来很流畅。
words.en: In music, legato indicates that musical notes are played or sung smoothly and connectedly.

words.tr: n. 拨奏曲；用指弹的乐曲; adj. 拨奏的; adv. 用拨奏
words.ex: The violinist used pizzicato to play the melody.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手用拨弦演奏这段旋律。
words.en: Pizzicato is a playing technique that involves plucking the strings of a string instrument. The term is also used to describe a passage of music played in this manner.

words.tr:
adj. 断音的；不连贯的
adv. 断音地；不连贯地
n. 断奏；断续的一段音乐
words.ex: The piano played staccato notes.
words.ex_cn: 钢琴弹奏了断奏的音符。
words.en: In music, staccato is a method of playing notes in a detached, separated manner, as opposed to legato.

words.ex: The violinist plays with a fast tremolo.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手用快速的颤音演奏。
words.en: A tremolo is a musical effect consisting of a rapid repetition of the same note or a rapid alternation between two notes.

words.ex: The violinist uses vibrato to make the sound softer.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手使用颤音让声音更柔和。
words.en: A musical effect consisting of a regular, pulsating change of pitch, used to add expression to vocal and instrumental music.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G5

words.ex: She sang a beautiful aria at the opera.
words.ex_cn: 她在歌剧上唱了一段优美的咏叹调。
words.en: An aria is a song for one voice in an opera, often expressing a character's emotions.

words.tr: n. 大胆的尝试；精湛的技艺
words.ex: Her bravura performance left the audience in awe.
words.ex_cn: 她精湛的表演让观众惊叹不已。
words.en: A bravura performance is one that is very skillful and exciting.

words.tr: n. 康塔塔；清唱剧；大合唱
words.ex: The choir sang a beautiful cantata last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期日，合唱团演唱了一首优美的清唱剧。
words.en: A cantata is a musical composition for voices and orchestra, typically in several movements, often involving a choir.

words.ex: He plays a violin concerto at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏一首小提琴协奏曲。
words.en: A concerto is a musical composition usually composed in three parts or movements, in which one solo instrument is accompanied by an orchestra.

words.ex: They sing a duet at the school concert.
words.ex_cn: 他们在学校音乐会上合唱二重唱。
words.en: A duet is a musical composition for two performers in which the performers have equal importance to the piece.

words.ex: The finale of the concert was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的终曲非常激动人心。
words.en: The finale is the last part of a piece of music, a performance, or a public event, especially when this is particularly dramatic or exciting.

words.tr: n. 间奏曲；插曲；幕间剧；芭蕾舞表演
words.ex: The intermezzo provided a brief respite from the intensity of the drama.
words.ex_cn: 间奏曲为紧张的戏剧情节提供了一个短暂的喘息机会。
words.en: An intermezzo is a short piece of music that is played between the main sections of a longer piece, or between acts of an opera.

words.tr: n. 剧本；歌词；歌剧脚本
words.ex: He wrote the libretto for a famous opera.
words.ex_cn: 他为一部著名的歌剧写了剧本。
words.en: The text of an opera or other long vocal work.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: The oratorio was performed by a large choir.
words.ex_cn: 清唱剧由一个大合唱团表演。
words.en: An oratorio is a large musical composition for orchestra, choir, and soloists. Like an opera, an oratorio includes the use of a choir, soloists, an ensemble, various distinguishable characters, and arias. However, opera is musical theatre, while oratorio is strictly a concert piece.

words.ex: The pianist played a lively scherzo at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首活泼的谐谑曲。
words.en: A scherzo is a light, playful movement or composition, typically in a fast tempo, found in symphonies, sonatas, and other musical works.

words.tr: adj. 单独的；独唱的；独奏的；
words.ex: He played a solo guitar piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首独奏吉他曲。
words.en: A solo is a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone, without any accompaniment.

words.ex: He plays a beautiful sonata on the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他用钢琴演奏一首优美的奏鸣曲。
words.en: A sonata is a piece of music written for one or two instruments that has three or four large sections that are different from each other but form a unified whole.

words.tr: n. 三人一组；三个一组；三重唱；三重奏；
words.ex: The trio sang a beautiful song together.
words.ex_cn: 这三人一组一起唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A trio is a group of three people who are performing together, especially in music.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G6

words.tr: n. 小配角；小品文；浮雕宝石
words.ex: She appeared in a cameo role in the film.
words.ex_cn: 她在电影中扮演了一个配角。
words.en: A cameo is a small but noticeable part in a film or play, often played by a famous actor or actress. It can also refer to a piece of jewelry consisting of a raised design on a background of a different color.

words.tr: n. 钟楼; n. （Campanile）人名；（意）坎帕尼莱
words.ex: The bell in the campanile rings every hour.
words.ex_cn: 钟楼里的钟每小时响一次。
words.en: A campanile is a bell tower, especially one that is freestanding rather than attached to a building.

words.tr: n. 长诗的篇章（相当于书的一章）
words.ex: The poem is divided into several cantos.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗被分为几个篇章。
words.en: A canto is a principal division of a long poem or a section of a song.

words.tr: n. （素描、油画的）明暗对比法；明暗对比效果；（文学、音乐等中的）对比法
words.ex: The painter used chiaroscuro to show light and dark.
words.ex_cn: 画家用明暗对照法来表现光影。
words.en: Chiaroscuro is an artistic technique developed during the Renaissance, characterized by the strong contrast between light and dark to give the illusion of volume in modeling three-dimensional objects and figures.

words.ex: The church has a small cupola on top.
words.ex_cn: 这座教堂顶部有一个小圆顶。
words.en: A cupola is a small, dome-shaped structure on top of a building, often used as a lookout or to admit light and air.

words.tr:
n. 壁画
v. 作壁画
words.ex: The artist painted a fresco on the church wall.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在教堂的墙上画了一幅湿壁画。
words.en: A fresco is a picture that is painted on a plastered wall when the plaster is still wet.

words.tr:
n. 凹雕
v. 凹雕
words.ex: The artist used intaglio to create a detailed image.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家使用凹雕术创作了一幅细节丰富的图像。
words.en: Intaglio is a technique in art where an image is created by cutting, carving, or engraving into a flat surface, making it a form of printmaking or sculpture.

words.tr: n. （意大利）由明亮的金属氧化物上光的可渗透陶器；（尤指19世纪英国的）仿意大利锡釉陶器
words.ex: She bought a majolica plate at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一个马约利卡陶盘。
words.en: Majolica is a type of Italian tin-glazed pottery dating from the Renaissance period, characterized by its colorful decoration.

words.tr: n. 中层楼；夹楼; adj. 中间的
words.ex: The tickets for the mezzanine are cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 楼座的票更便宜。
words.en: A mezzanine is an intermediate floor in a building which is partly open to the double-height ceilinged floor below. It is placed halfway up the wall on a floor which has a ceiling at least twice as high as a normal floor.

words.tr: n. 网线铜版；金属版印刷法; vt. 用网线铜版雕刻法刻
words.ex: He made a mezzotint of the old portrait.
words.ex_cn: 他制作了一幅旧肖像的蚀刻版画。
words.en: A method of engraving a copper plate by scraping and polishing the surface to create areas of light and shade.

words.tr: n. 铜绿锈；（金属表面的）绿锈；（旧木器等表面）年久而产生的光泽；（有点儿…的）样子
words.ex: The patina on the old bronze statue added to its charm.
words.ex_cn: 旧青铜雕像上的铜绿增添了它的魅力。
words.en: A patina is a thin layer that forms on the surface of something, especially metal, often as a result of age or exposure to the air, and that is usually green or brown.

words.tr: n. （有圆柱的）[建] 门廊；[建] 柱廊
words.ex: The house has a small portico at the front door.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的前门有一个小门廊。
words.en: A structure consisting of a roof supported by columns at regular intervals, typically attached as a porch to a building.

words.tr: n. 圆形建筑；圆形大厅
words.ex: The rotunda at the museum was a popular meeting spot.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆的圆形大厅是一个受欢迎的集合地点。
words.en: A rotunda is a large round room or building, especially one with a dome.

words.ex: The exterior of the building was covered in stucco.
words.ex_cn: 建筑的外墙覆盖着粉饰灰泥。
words.en: A type of plaster used for coating walls and ceilings, or for making architectural decorations.

words.tr: n. 蛋彩画颜料；蛋彩画法
words.ex: She used tempera to create vibrant and lasting artworks.
words.ex_cn: 她用蛋彩画法创作了色彩鲜艳且持久的艺术品。
words.en: A method of painting with pigments dispersed in an emulsion miscible with water, typically egg yolk.

words.ex: The pot is made of terra cotta.
words.ex_cn: 这个花盆是用陶土做的。
words.en: Terra cotta is a type of earthenware, a clay-based unglazed or glazed ceramic, where the fired body is porous. It has been used for pottery as well as for sculpture and architecture since ancient times.

words.ex: The statue has a strong torso.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像有一个强壮的躯干。
words.en: The main part of the human body, not including the head, arms, or legs.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G7

words.ex: He is a cognoscente of classical music.
words.ex_cn: 他是古典音乐的行家。
words.en: A cognoscente is a person with a great deal of knowledge about a subject, especially one of the arts.

words.tr: n. 半吊子；浅薄涉猎者；
words.ex: He is a dilettante who likes painting but never practices.
words.ex_cn: 他是个半吊子，喜欢画画但从不练习。
words.en: A dilettante is someone who studies or does something, but is not serious about it and does not have much knowledge.

words.tr: n. 艺术大师（尤值作曲家；指挥家等）；
words.ex: The maestro conducted the orchestra with great passion.
words.ex_cn: 这位大师充满激情地指挥了管弦乐队。
words.en: A maestro is a distinguished musician, especially a conductor of classical music.

words.tr:
n. 艺术名家；音乐演奏名家
adj. 技艺精湛的；功力深厚的
words.ex: He is a virtuoso on the violin.
words.ex_cn: 他是小提琴方面的天才。
words.en: A virtuoso is someone who is extremely skilled at doing something, especially playing a musical instrument.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G8

words.tr: phrase. 悠闲无事的快乐；无所事事的惬意
words.ex: He enjoys dolce far niente on the beach every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午都在海滩上享受无所事事的快乐。
words.en: The pleasant relaxation in carefree idleness.

words.ex: The party was a fiasco because no one came.
words.ex_cn: 派对是一场灾难，因为没人来。
words.en: A fiasco is something that is a complete failure, especially in a way that is very embarrassing or disappointing.

words.ex: The legal imbroglio complicated the company's expansion plans.
words.ex_cn: 法律上的纠葛使公司的扩张计划变得复杂。
words.en: An imbroglio is a very confusing or complicated situation.

words.tr:
adj. 隐姓埋名的；化名的
adv. 隐姓埋名地；匿名地
words.ex: He traveled incognito to avoid being recognized.
words.ex_cn: 他隐瞒身份旅行以避免被认出。
words.en: If someone does something incognito, they do it without letting people know who they are.

words.ex: He swore a vendetta against his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他向邻居发誓要报仇。
words.en: A vendetta is a prolonged bitter quarrel with or campaign against someone.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G9

words.tr: n. （意大利菜中的）开胃菜，餐前小吃
words.ex: He ate antipasto before the main meal.
words.ex_cn: 他在主菜前吃了开胃菜。
words.en: An antipasto is a traditional Italian appetizer consisting of a variety of meats, cheeses, and vegetables.

words.tr: n. 基安蒂（意大利产的一种红葡萄酒）
words.ex: He drank a glass of chianti with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐时喝了一杯基安蒂葡萄酒。
words.en: Chianti is a dry red wine produced in the Chianti region of central Tuscany, Italy. It is known for its robust flavor and is often associated with Italian cuisine.

words.ex: He cooked the meal with gusto.
words.ex_cn: 他做这顿饭时很有兴趣。
words.en: If you do something with gusto, you do it with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

chapters.name: 第七章 出自意大利语 G10

words.ex: The couple rode in a gondola along the canal.
words.ex_cn: 那对夫妇乘着贡多拉沿着运河行驶。
words.en: A gondola is a long, narrow boat that is used especially in Venice. It has a flat bottom and is moved along by someone standing at the back using a long pole.

words.ex: He found a small grotto behind the waterfall.
words.ex_cn: 他在瀑布后面发现了一个小岩洞。
words.en: A grotto is a small cave, especially an artificial one in a park or garden.

words.ex: The children played in the piazza after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在广场上玩耍。
words.en: A piazza is a public square or marketplace, especially in Italy.

words.ex: He showed his portfolio to the art teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向美术老师展示了他作品集。
words.en: A portfolio is a set of pictures by someone, or photographs of examples of their work, which they use when entering competitions or applying for work.

words.tr: n. （礼炮）齐鸣；（火炮）齐射；一阵；一连串
words.ex: The ship fired a salvo to honor the visiting admiral.
words.ex_cn: 船只为致敬来访的海军上将鸣放了礼炮齐鸣。
words.en: A salvo is the simultaneous discharge of artillery or other guns in a battle, or a sudden outburst of applause or other noise.

words.tr: phrase. 低声地；轻声地（尤指为避免被他人听见）
words.ex: He spoke sotto voce so no one else could hear.
words.ex_cn: 他轻声说话，以免别人听到。
words.en: If you say something sotto voce, you say it in a very quiet voice, often because you do not want to be overheard.

chapters.name: 第八章 出自西班牙语 G1

words.ex: He is an aficionado of classic movies.
words.ex_cn: 他是经典电影的爱好者。
words.en: An aficionado is someone who is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about a particular subject or activity.

words.tr: n. 骑手，骑师；（西班牙）绅士；（贵）妇人的护卫或陪伴; n. （Caballero）人名；（法）...
words.ex: The caballero rode his horse slowly through the village.
words.ex_cn: 这位绅士骑着马缓缓穿过村庄。
words.en: A caballero is a gentleman or knight, especially in Spanish-speaking countries, known for his chivalry and noble qualities.

words.tr: n. 征服者；西班牙征服者; n. （Conquistador）人名；（西）孔基斯塔多
words.ex: The conquistador explored new lands for Spain.
words.ex_cn: 这位征服者为西班牙探索了新土地。
words.en: A conquistador was a Spanish conqueror of Mexico and Peru in the 16th century.

words.ex: The town was terrorized by a gang of desperados.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇被一群亡命之徒所恐吓。
words.en: A desperado is a person who is ready to commit any illegal act, often without concern for their own safety.

words.ex: The duenna watched the girl closely.
words.ex_cn: 女管家密切地看着那个女孩。
words.en: A duenna is a woman who is employed to take care of a young woman, especially in Spanish-speaking countries, acting as a governess or chaperone.

words.ex: The gaucho rides a horse across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 高乔人骑马穿越平原。
words.en: A gaucho is a skilled horseman, reputed to be brave and unruly, who herds cattle in the South American pampas.

words.tr: n. 贵族；要人；大公（西班牙或葡萄牙最高爵位）
words.ex: The grandee lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A grandee is a person of high social rank or importance, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: n. 西班牙的绅士（低于最高贵族，大公）；西班牙的下级贵族; n. （Hidalgo）人名；（英、法...
words.ex: The hidalgo lived in a small village and owned land.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族住在一个小村庄里，拥有土地。
words.en: A hidalgo is a member of the Spanish or Portuguese nobility; a nobleman.

words.ex: The junta seized power in a military coup.
words.ex_cn: 军政府通过军事政变夺取了政权。
words.en: A junta is a military government that has taken power by force, not by election.

words.ex: The junto made decisions without asking others.
words.ex_cn: 这个小团体在不征求他人意见的情况下做出了决定。
words.en: A junto is a small group of people who join together to achieve a particular purpose, especially in politics, often secretly.

words.ex: The matador skillfully dodged the bull's charge.
words.ex_cn: 斗牛士巧妙地避开了公牛的冲撞。
words.en: A matador is a bullfighter who performs in a bullring, especially the one who kills the bull.

words.tr: n. 混血儿（尤指拉丁民族与印第安族的）
words.ex: The mestizo population is a significant part of the community.
words.ex_cn: 混血儿是社区中重要的一部分。
words.en: A person of mixed race, especially one having Spanish and indigenous American ancestry.

words.tr: n. 日工；劳工；雇农；被强制劳役以还债的工人; n. （Peon）人名；（俄、葡）佩翁
words.ex: The peon worked long hours in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 这名劳工在田里长时间工作。
words.en: A peon is a person who does hard physical work, especially in a job that does not require much skill and is not well paid.

words.tr: n. 骑马斗牛士（复数 picadors）；斗牛士之助手
words.ex: The picador rides a horse in the bullfight.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔骑着马参加斗牛比赛。
words.en: A picador is a bullfighter who uses a lance to weaken the bull by stabbing it in the neck muscles, typically on horseback.

words.ex: The picaro tricks the rich man to get food.
words.ex_cn: 这个流浪汉骗富人得到食物。
words.en: A picaro is a rogue or adventurer, especially in Spanish literature.

words.tr:
n. 叛徒；变节者；叛教者
adj. 背叛的；变节的
v. 背叛
words.ex: He is a renegade who left the team suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个突然离开团队的叛徒。
words.en: A renegade is a person who deserts and betrays an organization, country, or set of principles.

words.tr: n. 先生；（西班牙语）先生
words.ex: He is a senor at the high school.
words.ex_cn: 他是这所高中的高年级学生。
words.en: A title or form of address used of or to a Spanish-speaking man, corresponding to Mr. or sir.

words.ex: Senora Lopez sells bread at the market.
words.ex_cn: 洛佩兹夫人在市场卖面包。
words.en: A title or form of address for a married or older woman, used in Spanish-speaking countries.

words.tr: n. 小姐；女士（西班牙语中的尊称，相当于英语中的Miss）
words.ex: The senorita smiled at the boy.
words.ex_cn: 那位年轻女士对那个男孩笑了。
words.en: A title or form of address used of or to a Spanish-speaking unmarried woman, corresponding to Miss.

words.ex: The toreador waved his red cape at the bull.
words.ex_cn: 斗牛士向公牛挥动了他的红斗篷。
words.en: A toreador is a bullfighter, especially one who fights on horseback.

words.ex: The torero waved his red cape to the bull.
words.ex_cn: 斗牛士挥动他的红布引诱公牛。
words.en: A torero is a bullfighter, especially one who fights on foot.

words.tr: n. 牧童；放牛者；牧人; n. （Vaquero）人名；（葡）瓦克罗；（西）巴克罗
words.ex: The vaquero rides a horse and herds cattle.
words.ex_cn: 这位牛仔骑着马放牧牛群。
words.en: A cowboy, especially in Mexico or the southwestern United States.

chapters.name: 第八章 出自西班牙语 G2

words.tr: n. 风干土坯；风干砖坯；
words.ex: The old house was built with adobe bricks.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子是用风干土坯砖建造的。
words.en: Adobe is a natural building material made from sand, clay, water, and some kind of fibrous or organic material (sticks, straw, and/or manure), which the builders shape into bricks using frames and dry in the sun.

words.tr: n. （西班牙的）波列罗舞；（西班牙的）波列罗舞曲；一种前胸敞开的女用短上衣; n. （Bolero...
words.ex: He danced the bolero at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上跳了波莱罗舞。
words.en: A bolero is a type of traditional Spanish dance, or a short jacket worn over a dress.

words.ex: The gold mine became a bonanza for the town.
words.ex_cn: 这个金矿成了这个小镇的致富之源。
words.en: A bonanza is a situation or event that creates a sudden increase in wealth, good fortune, or profits.

words.ex: He talked with bravado, but he was scared.
words.ex_cn: 他装出勇敢的样子说话，但他其实很害怕。
words.en: A bold manner or a show of boldness intended to impress or intimidate.

words.tr: n. 小屋，有凉台的屋子
words.ex: He relaxed in a cabana by the pool.
words.ex_cn: 他在泳池边的凉棚里休息。
words.en: A small shelter or cabin, often with an open side facing a beach or swimming pool.

words.ex: She clicks the castanets while dancing.
words.ex_cn: 她跳舞时敲响响板。
words.en: Castanets are a percussion instrument used in Spanish, Kalo, Moorish, Ottoman, Italian, Sephardic, Swiss, and Portuguese music. They consist of a pair of concave shells joined on one edge by a string. They are held in the hand and used to produce clicks for rhythmic accents or a rapid series of clicks.

words.ex: The town holds an annual fiesta to celebrate its patron saint.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年都会举办一个节日来庆祝它的守护神。
words.en: A fiesta is a religious festival in Spanish-speaking countries, or a celebration or party.

words.ex: A small flotilla sailed across the bay.
words.ex_cn: 一支小型船队驶过了海湾。
words.en: A flotilla is a group of small ships, especially military ships.

words.ex: The farmer lives on a large hacienda in Mexico.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民住在墨西哥的一个大庄园里。
words.en: In Spanish-speaking countries, a hacienda is a large estate or plantation with a dwelling house.

words.tr: adj. 不得与外界交流的；不愿被打扰的; adv. 不得与外界交流地；不愿被打扰地
words.ex: The suspect was held incommunicado for two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 嫌疑人被隔离了两周，不得与外界交流。
words.en: If someone is being held incommunicado, they are not allowed to talk to anyone outside the place where they are, especially to journalists or lawyers.

words.tr: n. 女用小披风，连披肩之头纱; n. （Mantilla）人名；（西）曼蒂利亚
words.ex: She wore a beautiful mantilla to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她在婚礼上戴了一条漂亮的女用小披风。
words.en: A mantilla is a traditional Spanish lace or silk veil or shawl worn over the head and shoulders, often over a high comb called a peineta, and is particularly associated with the Catholic Church and traditional Spanish dress.

words.tr: n. 一页，页码；对开纸；对开本的书; adj. 对开的，对折的; vt. 编页码; n. （Fol...
words.ex: Please turn to the next folio.
words.ex_cn: 请翻到下一页。
words.en: A folio is a book or manuscript consisting of large sheets of paper folded in half to make two leaves or four pages.

words.ex: He committed a peccadillo by arriving a few minutes late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到几分钟而犯了一个小错误。
words.en: A peccadillo is a small, unimportant fault or sin.

words.ex: He wears a poncho when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨时他穿一件篷风衣。
words.en: A poncho is a piece of clothing that consists of a large piece of material, usually waterproof, with a hole in the middle for the head.

words.ex: The pueblo is old and has stone houses.
words.ex_cn: 这个普韦布洛很古老，有石屋。
words.en: A pueblo is a type of Indian village built by certain peoples in the south-western United States, especially one consisting of multistorey adobe houses built by the Pueblo people.

words.ex: He takes a siesta after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后小睡一会儿。
words.en: A siesta is a short sleep or rest which you have in the early afternoon, especially in hot countries.

words.tr: n. 玉米粉薄烙饼，玉米粉圆饼
words.ex: He eats a tortilla for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃玉米饼。
words.en: A tortilla is a type of thin, flat bread made from finely ground wheat flour or cornmeal, originally made in Mexico.

chapters.name: 第八章 出自西班牙语 G3

words.tr: n. 旱谷；干涸的沟壑；峡谷；小河
words.ex: The rain filled the arroyo with water.
words.ex_cn: 雨水填满了干涸的河床。
words.en: An arroyo is a steep-sided gully cut by running water in an arid or semiarid region.

words.tr: n. 野马（美国西部的）; n. （Bronco）人名；（葡）布龙科
words.ex: He rode a bronco at the ranch.
words.ex_cn: 他在牧场骑了一匹野马。
words.en: A bronco is a wild or half-tamed horse of the western US.

words.ex: The burro carried heavy loads across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 这头驴子在沙漠中驮着重物。
words.en: A burro is a small donkey used as a pack animal, especially in the southwestern United States.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep canyon.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深峡谷。
words.en: A canyon is a large valley with very steep sides and usually a river flowing along the bottom.

words.ex: The dye came from indigo plants.
words.ex_cn: 这种染料来自靛青植物。
words.en: A deep blue dye obtained from the indigo plant, or a color between blue and violet in the spectrum.

words.tr: adv. 明天；在明天；推迟到明天
words.ex: I'll finish the project mañana.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会完成这个项目。
words.en: Tomorrow; the future.

words.ex: The cowboy rode his horse on the mesa.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔骑着马在台地上奔跑。
words.en: A mesa is a flat-topped mountain or hill with steep sides, found primarily in the southwestern United States.

words.tr: n. 野马（产于墨西哥和北美平原）；海军行伍出身的军官（美国俚语）
words.ex: The mustang is a symbol of the American West.
words.ex_cn: 野马是美国西部的象征。
words.en: A mustang is a small, strong wild horse that lives on the plains of North America.

words.tr: n. 草原；蒲苇（pampa 的复数形式）; n. （Pampas）人名；（瑞典）潘帕斯
words.ex: The vast pampas stretch for miles in all directions.
words.ex_cn: 广阔的潘帕斯草原向四面八方延伸数英里。
words.en: The pampas are the vast grassy plains of South America, found primarily in Argentina and extending into Uruguay.

words.ex: He climbed the sierra with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们爬了山。
words.en: A sierra is a mountain range, especially in Spain or Spanish America.
